Traditional [[Cookbook:Chai Tea|chai]] has numerous variations, depending on which region it is brewed. This is a simple recipe with milk, sugar, and spices. 

== Ingredients == 
*[[Cookbook:Cardamom|Cardamom]]
*[[Cookbook:Cinnamon|Cinnamon]]
*[[Cookbook:Ginger|Ginger]], grated
*2 spoons [[Cookbook:Tea Leaves|tea leaves]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
*[[Cookbook:Sugar|Sugar]] to taste

== Procedure ==
#Bring 1 ½ cups water to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], add the fresh spices, and boil for 1 minute.
#Add the tea leaves, cover, and [[Cookbook:Steeping|steep]] for 3–5 minutes
#Bring the milk to a boil.
#[[Cookbook:Strainer|Strain]] the tea mixture to remove the solids.
#Add milk and sugar, and serve hot with samosas or kachoris.
